homepageTopArticles.title: Shopify debuts Canvas, a way to build online stores by chatting with AI
homepageTopArticles.snippet: Shopify’s new Canvas site builder lets merchants create and customize their online stores by chatting with its AI agent Sidekick, while watching the changes happen in real time.

homepageTopArticles.title: Pandora expands manufacturing capacity by 50% with Vietnam facility
homepageTopArticles.snippet:
Retail Jeweller
Pandora expands manufacturing capacity by 50% with Vietnam facility
Jewellery behemoth Pandora has opened a $150m manufacturing facility in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, increasing its production capacity by 50% and establishing its first production site outside Thailand.
Pandora expands manufacturing capacity by 50% with Vietnam facility
Ruth Faulkner
homepageTopArticles.aiSummary: Pandora opened a $150m facility in Ho Chi Minh City, boosting manufacturing capacity by 50% and marking its first production site outside Thailand.
